s1.syndrome_frame: Chronic multisystem disease with autoimmune features, characterized by skin, joint, and lung involvement, with a prolonged course and significant weight loss
salient_findings: Symmetric swelling of metacarpophalangeal and interphalangeal joints with ulcers
Dyspigmentation and atrophy of distal fingers
Bibasilar rales and restrictive lung disease
Elevated ferritin and lymphocytopenia
Positive anti-SSA (Ro) and anticardiolipin antibodies
key_facts: 7-month history of fatigue, exertional dyspnea, arthralgias, and hand swelling
50-pound weight loss
Previous hospitalization for hypoxia
Prior treatment with prednisone
Normal capillaroscopy
Ulcerated lichenoid papules on palmar IP creases
Oxford Scale muscle strength 5 of 5 throughout
Elevated ferritin (1543 ng/mL)
Depressed creatine kinase (32 U/L)
Lymphocytopenia with CD3: 328 μL, CD4: 233 μL, CD8: 85 μL
Positive anti-SSA (Ro) and anticardiolipin antibodies
Normal prothrombin time, partial thromboplastin time, and tissue thromboplastin
Chest CT showed hilar lymphadenopathy, interstitial thickening, and perilymphatic ground glass opacities
Pulmonary function tests showed restrictive disease with decreased diffusing capacity (33% predicted)

shortlist.label: Systemic lupus erythematosus
shortlist.why_kept: Positive anti-SSA (Ro) and anticardiolipin antibodies, lymphocytopenia, and multisystem involvement

shortlist.label: Rheumatoid arthritis
shortlist.why_kept: Symmetric joint swelling, ulcers on dorsal MCPs, and positive anti-SSA (Ro) antibodies

shortlist.label: Sarcoidosis
shortlist.why_kept: Hilar lymphadenopathy, interstitial lung disease, and skin involvement

shortlist.label: Vasculitis
shortlist.why_kept: Ulcerated lichenoid papules, diffuse vasculopathy, and fibrin thrombi in deep dermal vessels

shortlist.label: Interstitial lung disease
shortlist.why_kept: Chest CT showing interstitial thickening and perilymphatic ground glass opacities, and pulmonary function tests showing restrictive disease

raw.rationale: The patient's presentation of hilar lymphadenopathy, interstitial lung disease, skin lesions, and elevated ferritin levels are consistent with sarcoidosis. The normal capillaroscopy and absence of anti-Scl-70 antibodies also make other diagnoses less likely.

rejected.label: Systemic lupus erythematosus
rejected.why: The patient lacks typical lupus features such as a positive lupus anticoagulant and anti-dsDNA antibodies.

rejected.label: Rheumatoid arthritis
rejected.why: The patient's joint symptoms and laboratory results do not meet the typical criteria for rheumatoid arthritis, and the presence of hilar lymphadenopathy is not typical for this disease.

rejected.label: Vasculitis
rejected.why: While the patient has some features of vasculitis, such as skin ulcers and elevated anticardiolipin antibodies, the overall clinical picture is more consistent with sarcoidosis.

rejected.label: Interstitial lung disease
rejected.why: Interstitial lung disease is a feature of the patient's presentation, but it is not a specific diagnosis and does not account for the other systemic features of the patient's illness.
